faq.refusal_reply: I don't have program material that answers that, and I'd rather not guess about a policy. Please check with MSBA advising — you can book time with them from the Appointments tab.
faq._comment: Retrieval gates and the refusal for the Resources bot (services/resources/bot.py). Its prompt is the skill file services/resources/skills/answer_from_passages/SKILL.md, editable on the server like every other prompt; it is deliberately not overlaid from here. web_race_below: when the best retrieved passage's cosine is under this, the web answer is prepared in parallel with the passages answer and used only if the passages decline to answer -- one extra model call on thin corpus support, in exchange for not paying two round trips in sequence. 0 disables the race.
faq.out_of_scope_reply: That's outside what I can help with — I answer questions about the MSBA programme, UC San Diego services and your studies here. Ask me about any of those; for programme matters that need a person, MSBA advising is bookable from the Appointments tab.

career._comment: Retrieval gates for the career bot. Its prompt is services/resources/skills/career_advice/SKILL.md.

electives._comment: Retrieval gates for the FACTUAL route on the courses surface (services/orchestrator.py). The prompts that used to live here went with the four-step interview: extract_prompt, explain_prompt and intake_extract_prompt drove an extractor and a presenter that no longer exist, and system_prompt was never read by anything. The factual route's prompt is FACTUAL_SYSTEM in the orchestrator, beside the grounding rule it enforces; it is deliberately not tunable from here, because relaxing "answer only from the material below" at runtime is the one change that must go through review.
